notes: Same methodology as MAA (Chennai): SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census city-wide workplace total for Kolkata, redistributed across all 141 KMC (pre-2012) wards using real 2011 Census worker counts. All 141 wards matched a Census figure directly, no modeled proxy weighting needed. (Note: the ward boundary source stored coordinates in [lat, lon] order instead of GeoJSON's [lon, lat], so this was corrected on load; this affected geometry alignment only, not the underlying data or its granularity.) Jobs placed within wards via OSM building footprints by type; population and commute data follow the standard project pipeline.
